item.title: Araghchi’s message of appreciation to President Pezeshkian: Diplomacy is at forefront of defending Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Following the selection of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as the "Outstanding Agency" in the "Yavar-e Fath" (Supporter of Victory) category of the 21st Shahid Rajaei Festival, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi issued a message to President Masoud Pezeshkian expressing appreciation for the support and confidence shown by him and the government toward the Ministry.

Tehran, IRNA – Following the selection of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as the "Outstanding Agency" in the "Yavar-e Fath" (Supporter of Victory) category of the 21st Shahid Rajaei Festival, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi issued a message to President Masoud Pezeshkian expressing appreciation for the support and confidence shown by him and the government toward the Ministry.

item.title: 40th International Islamic Unity Conference opens in Tehran
item.description: The 40th International Islamic Unity Conference opened on Thursday (August 27) in Iran’s capital, Tehran. President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the conference that focuses on promoting the ideas and vision of the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/photo/86247685/40th-International-Islamic-Unity-Conference-opens-in-Tehran

The 40th International Islamic Unity Conference opened on Thursday (August 27) in Iran’s capital, Tehran. President Masoud Pezeshkian addressed the conference that focuses on promoting the ideas and vision of the martyred Leader of the Islamic Revolution, Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei.
